'''Nippet''' was a hunter in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who married a water spirit. "Nippet" was a popular name given to [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Nippet/Legends|the daughter]] of [[Lumat/Legends|Lumat]] and [[Zephee/Legends|Zephee]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|nippet|Nippet}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nippet was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
